description: This source file implements the RequestHandler class for managing application storage, including creating, retrieving, deleting storage, and handling persistent properties. It also includes directory traversal and validation functions.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: Handles application storage management, including creation, deletion, retrieval, and persistent property handling.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of RequestHandler.

methods.name: setCurrentService
methods.description: Sets the current service interface for the handler.

methods.name: populateAppInfoCacheFromStoragePath
methods.description: Populates the internal storage info cache by scanning the storage directory.

methods.name: createPersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Creates the remote persistent store object.

methods.name: releasePersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Releases the persistent store object.

methods.name: isValidAppStorageDirectory
methods.description: Validates if a directory name is a proper application ID.

methods.name: appQuotaSizeProperty
methods.description: Gets, sets, or deletes the quota size property for an app in persistent storage.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Callback used by nftw to accumulate directory size.

methods.name: getDirectorySizeInBytes
methods.description: Calculates total size of a directory by traversing its contents.

methods.name: createAppStorageInfoByAppID
methods.description: Creates or updates storage info map entry for an app.

methods.name: retrieveAppStorageInfoByAppID
methods.description: Retrieves storage info for an app, verifying accessibility.

methods.name: removeAppStorageInfoByAppID
methods.description: Removes storage info for an app.

methods.name: hasEnoughStorageFreeSpace
methods.description: Checks if enough free space is available for new storage.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for an app with specified size.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage info and location for an app.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage for an app.

methods.name: deleteCallback
methods.description: NFTW callback to delete files and directories.

methods.name: deleteDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries within a directory.

methods.name: lockAppStorageInfo
methods.description: Locks storage info for thread-safe access.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specific app.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all app data except exempted apps.

methods.name: SetBaseStoragePath
methods.description: Sets the base path for storage.
